GC.problem: Misleading for the command design: the note says 'the client sends an aim direction'. The legacy game aims at a point in the world, not along a direction. Each shot's direction is rebuilt from the fire origin to aimPoint, and aimPoint comes from the camera ray hitting the world as the client sees it. If v2 sends only a direction, any server correction of the fire origin moves the shot off target, and the server would lose the view time it needs to rewind for lag compensation.
GC.evidence: shamble-game.js:1473: aimDir.copy(aimPoint).sub(_fireO). aimPoint is set from the SIM hit of the camera ray at :1126-1129, against soldier positions as the client sees them.
GC.fix_op: {"id": "GC3", "field": "v2_note", "op": "replace", "find": "The client sends an aim direction; the server re-resolves the shot.", "text": "Legacy aims at a world point, not a direction: each pellet's direction is aimPoint minus playerFireOrigin (1473), and aimPoint is the camera ray's hit in the SIM as the client sees it (1126-1129). So the v2 command should carry the quantised aim point (or the camera ray) with the client's view time; the server rebuilds the direction from its own fire origin and re-resolves the shot against the world rewound to that time. A bare direction would shift the shot by any correction of the fire origin."}
